name: Late Blight (Leaf)
symptoms: Dark brown to black leaf spots Leaf edges turn pale and die Rapid wilting of infected leaves
description: A devastating disease of potato and tomato leaves, causing dark brown spots and rapid leaf death. Can destroy crops quickly under wet conditions.
management: Plant resistant cultivars Remove and destroy infected leaves Improve air circulation with proper spacing and pruning Rotate crops to prevent inoculum buildup
prevention: Avoid overhead irrigation Use certified disease-free seeds or tubers Remove plant debris after harvest
